metadata.note: DEUS bestiary adaptation layer (DEC-050 item 3, DEC-053 item 2, DEC-057): one row per SRD 5.1 creature, keyed by its srd: id. Generated; do not hand-edit. srd51 is never edited. Not loaded by any plugin yet; runtime spawning is a later leaf.

placementRules.seeded: Rolled by the seeded spawner in each of the row's cells, filtered by the cell's danger tier; frequency weights the draw.
placementRules.lair: Source frequency 'lair': anchored to a lair site in one of the row's cells; never a wandering spawn.
placementRules.summon: Source role SUMMON-ONLY: enters the world only when summoned; never rolled by the seeded spawner. Its cells say where it belongs.
placementRules.none: Source role EXCLUDE: no cell; never placed.
